title.narrative: Revitalize and reinforce the MAB and Geopark Programmes in the Maghreb

description.narrative: The workplan “Revitalize and reinforce the MAB and Geopark Programmes in the Maghreb” aims to strengthen the implementation and regional coherence of UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere (MAB) and Global Geoparks Programmes across the Maghreb region, with the objective of enhancing governance and management effectiveness of the regional network of biosphere reserves and geoparks. In a context marked by increasing environmental pressures, including climate change, biodiversity loss, and growing demands for sustainable territorial development, the plan aspires to reinforce the role of MAB sites and Geoparks as living laboratories for sustainability, education, and community engagement. Activities will focus on having new biosphere reserves and geoparks and strengthen the managerial dynamics of existing ones, organizing regional coordination meeting and online capacity-building workshops, supporting joint communication and cooperation. The plan will partly aim to developing strategic tools to enhance governance, networking, and integration of these programmes into national and regional development frameworks.
